title: fed: Peer/unsubscribePresence MUST silently succeed
description: Peer/unsubscribePresence says 'Servers MUST silently succeed if no active subscription exists for the given subscriberId.' Idempotency on no-op is good practice but 'silently succeed' as a MUST is over-specified — a server could return an informational response or log the no-op without breaking the protocol. Decision: change to SHOULD silently succeed, allowing implementations to log or return informational status.
close_reason: Dropped 'silently' from 'MUST silently succeed' — idempotency guarantee preserved, implementation not over-constrained to suppress logging or informational responses.
